title: Executive Order No. 133, s. 2021
text:
MALACANAN PALACE
MANILA

BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 133

INCREASING THE MINIMUM ACCESS VOLUME FOR PORK MEAT
UNDER REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8178 OR THE “AGRICULTURAL
TARIFFICATION ACT,” AS AMENDED

WHEREAS, the spread of the African Swine Fever to over 12 regions of the
country, including 38 provinces and 437 municipalities, has led to the significant
reduction of the country’s swine inventory by three (3) million heads or 24.1% from
2020 to 2021; :

WHEREAS, data from the Department of Agriculture (DA) National Livestock
Program show that for the year 2021, the shortage of pork in the country is estimated
to be around 388,790 meiric tons (MT);

WHEREAS, Section 6 of Republic Act (RA) No. 8178 or the “Agricultural
Tariffication Act,” as amended by RA No. 11203, provides that in case of shortages or
abnormal price increases in agricultural products whose quantitative restrictions have
been lifted, the President may propose revisions, modifications or adjustments of the
minimum access volume (MAV) to Congress, which has to act within fifteen (15) days
from receipt of the proposal, otherwise the same shall be deemed approved;

WHEREAS, on 26 March 2021, to quell the existing shortage, decrease retail
prices, and stabilize inflation, the President submitted to Congress a proposal to
increase the 2021 MAV for pork meat by 350,000 MT, or from 54,210 MT to 404,210
MT; ,

WHEREAS, the Congress has not acted on the proposal to increase the MAV
for pork meat within the prescribed period;

WHEREAS, following a detailed review of existing measures and interventions,
taking into account the issuance of Executive Order No. 128 (s. 2021), which
effectively reduced the importation of pork products at lower tariff rates, it has been
subsequently recommended that the MAV allocation for the year 2021 be increased
by 200,000 MT instead of 350,000 MT; and

WHEREAS, it is imperative to immediately address the current supply gap in ©

pork meat, to provide consumers with adequate and affordable food, and to lower -
inflation;

THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
 
NOW, THEREFORE, I, RODRIGO ROA DUTERTE, President of the Republic
of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by the Constitution and existing
laws, do hereby order:

Section 1. Increase in MAV of Pork. The MAV of pork meat for the MAV Year
2021 of 54,210 MT is hereby increased to 254,210 MT, provided that any unavailable
balance at the end of 2021 shall not be carried over to 2022.

Section 2. Allocation of MAV to Importers. The MAV Management
Committee is hereby directed to ensure that the allocation of the volume importation
is fair and open to all qualified importers of pork meat, and in accordance with existing
rules and regulations for the implementation of the agricultural MAVs, and other
pertinent laws and regulations.

Section 3. Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately upon
publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.

DONE, in the City of Manila, this 1or Way of May , in the year of our
Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty One.

 

By the President:

SALVADOR C. MEDIALDEA
